bind.text: !has:UI.BasketArena.State ? 'Waiting for the arena…' : !UI.BasketArena.State.bHasArena ? UI.BasketArena.State.Message : "{UI.BasketArena.State.SlotCapacity} cells, {UI.BasketArena.State.GridWidth} wide"

children.text: Granted in order into an emptied bag. A compartment and cell put the stack there afterwards (row-major, 0 = top-left); an occupant swaps. Blank = routed like a pickup. The last box is wear (0-100).

bind.text: UI.BasketArena.State.bHasArena ? "The bag has {UI.BasketArena.State.SlotCapacity} cells right now ({UI.BasketArena.State.GridWidth} per row). A backpack adds its bonus slots when Apply wears it." : ''

children.text: Dropped as physics items in a line in front of you, to pick up into the basket.

Spawned on Apply, replacing the last ones, each turned to face you and spaced by its size. Holds: one compartment per line. Working, full and done lock in whatever the input makes; full packs the output so the work waits at 100%.

children.placeholder: e.g. Full bag, bread on floor

children.text: Saved per machine. Load and Load default fill the sheet; they do not apply. F10 also sweeps the floor and puts you back on the mark.
